info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Session Dialogue Update API enables businesses to modify session dialogues across various channels using specific parameters. This endpoint allows for targeted updates to enhance user interactions and improve the overall customer experience. Typical consumers include application developers and platform integrators seeking to fine-tune cross-channel communication. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure that their content and dialogue strategies are consistently aligned with user needs.

patch.description: This operation allows clients to update the session dialogue identified by the unique resource ID 'RES-100045'. Use this endpoint to modify the existing session dialogue data as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the session dialogue with the specified ID. It allows for partial modifications of the session dialogue attributes. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the schema structure to avoid errors.
